objective: Make staging publishes trustworthy before any Neon Spire publish: find and record why the Bake Rush staging place showed only a baseplate, add a build stamp that the server logs and the menu shows, add a restart-servers step to the publish checklist, and (if SHANNON approves the key scope) a post-publish Luau Execution check that the published version contains the expected scripts and stamp.
acceptance_criteria: The baseplate root cause is written in PILOT-004 notes and this task's evidence, with how it was confirmed
A build stamp (commit SHA) is written into the place by CI and publish.yml, logged by the server at start and visible in a corner label in every place
CI and publish.yml check the built file contains every project node, its scripts and the commit's stamp before upload (tools/check-place.mjs)
publish.yml fails when the published version's stamp or expected instances do not match the commit (tools/verify-publish.mjs, Open Cloud Luau execution)
The publish run summary says to restart running servers, or restarts them when ROBLOX_RESTART_SERVERS is enabled
SHANNON joins a staging place and reports the stamp matching the published commit (gate G0)
verification: Tool tests (node --test tools/place-check/place-check.test.mjs) and Kit.spec BuildStamp cases in CI; one verified staging publish run; gate G0 note from SHANNON with the stamp and F9 log line; reviewed by A04
notes: Medium risk: touches the release workflow. Taken over by the pipeline thread (PIPE-001) on 2026-10-31; the Neon Spire thread hands it over and waits on it. Remaining for acceptance, both SHANNON only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): (1) add the scope universe.place.luau-execution-session:write for the staging universe to the staging environment's ROBLOX_API_KEY (optionally universe:write plus variable ROBLOX_RESTART_SERVERS=true), (2) one staging publish and a G0 note with the stamp seen in the corner label and the F9 [Build] line. The baseplate root cause is still open: the first verified publish rules out suspect 4 (wrong file) and, with the stamp, suspect 1 (old server). No production publish.
